title: Qwen3.6-27B pair-produced full-attention Q source-F16 full-engine qualification

counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.protocol: One resident session per board/shape; prior policy and candidate warmed; seven alternating pairs; each synthetic policy flip clears the dispatch cache; baseline removes only the K5120/N12288 full-Q source-F16 policy while retaining all other Q4/Q5/Q6 policies; p512/p1024/p4096 plus d128.

counterbalanced_full_engine_ab.interpretation: M512/M1024 are the binding changed-route rows. M4096 resolves the exact same owner under both labels and is a neutrality/fallback control, not a candidate speed claim. Decode also resolves identical exact owners; the focused XTX confirmation is -0.154% and rejects the noisy initial label split.

production_kernel_trace.note: The prefill-only trace validates named production ownership. Its profiler-perturbed wall and null preview token are not correctness or throughput evidence; the complete category and engine matrices are the correctness/topline authorities.

validation.runtime_unit: Committed in ec288d731 after 128 passed and 9 skipped across affected kernel, registry, dispatch, scratch-liveness, and runner coverage.
validation.full_engine: Binding M512/M1024 rows improve on both boards with 26/28 paired wins, exact trajectories, byte-identical tracked peaks, and strict extra pair-owner counts; M4096 is exact fallback.
validation.quality: Ten prompts/four categories pass 330/330 top-1, max KL 0.007551, deterministic repeats, and 960 asserted full-Q pair launches.
validation.decode_memory: Focused XTX decode is -0.154% under identical owners; selector-unset decode and tracked peaks remain stable at all six cells.
validation.mtp_dflash: Full llama-compatible B1-B3 output/acceptance safeguard is exact and tears down to zero. DFlash is a different model/plugin scope and cannot enter this Qwen3.6-27B-only M512+ policy; peer/model misses are unit-gated exact fallbacks.

decision: Retain the row-bounded pair-produced full-attention-Q source-F16 route as the Qwen3.6-27B gfx1100 default for M512-M2047. It improves both admitted engine rows on both boards, advances XTX 1K and 4K beyond the frozen HIP+1% prefill gates, preserves decode/memory/MTP ownership, and keeps M2048/4K exact. Re-profile the retained XTX M512 package before selecting the next materially distinct lane.
